🦙 Lima • Cusco • Machu Picchu — 8 days

Peru, sorted.

Barranco murals and a cooking class in Lima, then up to Cusco for the big one — Machu Picchu at sunrise — plus a turquoise lake, ancient terraces, and one last night back in Lima. Everything in one place for the group, llamas included.

🦙 If there's time — the idea pile

Not booked, not promised. Pick from these for the Cusco flex day or a Lima extension — don't try to do them all.

🌈 Rainbow Mountain

Vinicunca's striped ridges — red, gold, and turquoise mineral bands. A high-altitude day trip from Cusco (~16,500 ft at the top), so it's the ambitious pick for Sun Nov 22 if everyone acclimated well.

🏛️ Sacred Valley

The gentler big day: Ollantaytambo and Pisac terraces, markets, and river-valley views between Cusco and Machu Picchu. Best all-rounder if you want ruins without another extreme-altitude push.

🦭 Paracas

Coast day from Lima: Ballestas Islands sea lions and birds, plus the Paracas Reserve's desert-meets-ocean cliffs. A full-day detour — only fits if you steal a Lima day.

🏜️ Huacachina

Peru's desert oasis near Ica — dunes, sandboarding, and buggies at sunset. Often paired with Paracas as one long day from Lima. Golden-hour photos are the whole point.

Notes & errands 🦙

The things that are easy to forget until it's too late.

  1. 📚 A book for AnandBring one English book to leave behind for Anand in Peru. Pack it where you'll actually find it — not at the bottom under the hiking layers.
  2. ✏️ Stationery stopStop at a stationery store in Lima or Cusco. Easiest in Lima on Wed Nov 18, or in Cusco old town on Fri Nov 20. Don't leave it for Machu Picchu day.
  3. 🥾 Altitude is realCusco ~11,150 ft, Humantay ~13,800 ft, Rainbow Mountain even higher. The plan already builds in a gentle Fri Nov 20 — keep it gentle.
